title: IDOR + Insufficient Jinja2 Sandbox in /api/storage_paths/test/
summary:
## Summary

The `StoragePathViewSet.test()` endpoint at `POST /api/storage_paths/test/` has two compounding issues that allow any authenticated user (regardless of role or permissions) to read the content of other documents in the system, as well as extract user information.

## Vulnerability Details

### 1. Missing Object-Level Permission Check (IDOR)
### 2. Insufficient Jinja2 Sandbox Allows Data Exfiltration
